name: dsfd_capt_x8_dual-v3-COMMIT
purpose: Actual assigned-pin repair after wide v2 DRC1: CK61.548 conflicts with f_w24861.596 on M5 (spacing bbox61.560,0..61.584,0.227). Die-reviewed6e20fb09c relocates scalar controls to vacant east centres114.012/114.204/114.396, actual44M5PG rectangles clear both faces and1.392um nearest stripe clearance (reviewda5faf138). Outline123.12x136.08, data pins and transaction semantics retained. Corrected golden-bench monitor indices isolate timeout counter; exact9PASS and observed KSWAP121697 mismatches/zero timeouts at b2b1fc71a.
